uncited: **Inputs:** Time-varying volume data consisting of $T$ time steps, each with spatial dimensions $N \times N \times N$.
User-specified spatial error tolerance ($\epsilon_s$) and temporal error tolerance ($\epsilon_t$).
Block size $n$ (number of voxels per initial subvolume).

**Outputs:** A unified spatio-temporal hierarchical data structure (WTSP tree) containing compressed wavelet coefficients and low-pass filtered subblocks, along with hierarchical error metrics for each node.
*   *Optimization:* If the data block is uniform, skip the transform.
**Thresholding:** Compare wavelet coefficients against a user-specified threshold.
**Octree Assembly:** Recursively group low-pass filtered subblocks from eight neighboring subvolumes into a single block of $n$ voxels to form the parent node.
This produces a binary time tree similar to the error tree algorithm [MVW98].
*   **Block Size ($n$):** Size of the initial spatial subvolume in voxels.
*   **Spatial Threshold:** User-specified threshold for clamping spatial wavelet coefficients.
*   **Spatial Error Tolerance ($\epsilon_s$):** User-specified tolerance for spatial approximation error.
*   **Temporal Error Tolerance ($\epsilon_t$):** User-specified tolerance for temporal approximation error.
*   **Uniform Data Blocks:** If a data block is uniform, skip the 3D wavelet transform.
Spatial error ($s_e$) and temporal error ($t_e$) are calculated for each time tree node during the bottom-up construction of the WTSP tree.
